images.prompt: A mountain lakeside path with one empty wooden bench in the foreground, a red rowboat near the bank and two layered blue mountain ridges under a pale cloudy sky. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The bench, red rowboat, shoreline, tree and layered mountain lake form a coherent natural travel photograph with clear foreground and background relationships and no text.

images.actual_source_analysis: A weathered wooden bench fills the lower left foreground beside a gravel lakeside path. One red wooden rowboat floats close to the shore at right. A leafy tree frames the upper left and top. Blue lake water lies before layered forested mountain ridges beneath a pale cloudy sky. Rocks and grass line the near shore; no people or lettering.
